subject.title: OpenWebUI image uploads reach image tool as empty image via /v1/chat/completions on 2026.5.18

question: Should this issue wait for a raw OpenWebUI image-upload request capture before repair, or should a maintainer sponsor a broader OpenWebUI image-upload compatibility investigation now?
rationale: Current main covers standard `image_url` chat-completions parts, but the reported 2026.5.18 failure is narrower and cannot be located without the actual OpenWebUI payload or live repro.

options.title: Require request capture first
options.body: Keep this open in needs-info/manual review until a redacted OpenWebUI request capture or live current-main reproduction identifies the exact unsupported payload shape.

options.title: Sponsor investigation now
options.body: Assign a maintainer to run an OpenWebUI image-upload E2E and patch whichever drop point appears, accepting that the first step is exploratory.

recommendation.title: Require request capture first
recommendation.body: Keep this open in needs-info/manual review until a redacted OpenWebUI request capture or live current-main reproduction identifies the exact unsupported payload shape.

likelyOwner.reason: Vincent introduced and recently maintained the relevant OpenAI-compatible chat-completions image path.
